Chromium Windows notification-area ABI reference

The interoperability declarations are based on publicly available ABI definitions
in status_tray_state_changer_win.h and status_tray_state_changer_win.cc.
Copyright 2014 The Chromium Authors.
The process isolation, validation, bounded enumeration, ownership and policy
implementation in this project was written independently.

Sources:
https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/a4993e2d04893594d4e5b3f4fa5ed1c51d13f824/chrome/browser/ui/views/status_icons/status_tray_state_changer_win.cc
https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/4a8573cb240df29b0e4d9820303538fb28e31d84/chrome/browser/ui/views/status_icons/status_tray_state_changer_win.h
